programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: He Said, She Shed: The homeowners association deny Claire's request to build a 'She Shed' in the garden, and only Luke and Phil know the real reason why.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The Mixing Bowl: Bijou New York diner The Mixing Bowl is haemorrhaging money thanks to manager Mike's out-of-control marketing plans. Can Gordon get things back on track?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Itchy and Scratchy: The Movie: While Homer and Marge are at parents' evening, Bart breaks the babysitter's teeth. So Homer vows never to let him see the Itchy and Scratchy film.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge Gets a Job: When Marge gets a job at the power plant, Mr Burns falls in love with her and invites her over to dinner, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: New Kid on the Block: When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa's First Word: The family try to get Maggie to say her first word. But Homer's glad that she hasn't spoken yet, because all Lisa and Bart do is talk back to him.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer's Triple Bypass: Homer has a heart attack while he's watching TV. The hospital says he needs a bypass, but Homer can't afford it. Of course, there's always Dr Nick...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Selma's Choice: After Homer gets sick from a giant sandwich he's been eating for months, Selma steps in to take the kids to a new alcohol-based theme park.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: O Brother, Where Bart Thou?: Bart grows jealous of Lisa's relationship with Maggie and heads to an orphanage to find a baby brother. Guest starring Kim Cattrall.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Thursdays with Abie: Grampa tells a journalist about his wartime service on a battleship. The story brings Grampa lots of attention, but his relationship with Homer suffers.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Once Upon a Time in Springfield: Krusty gets a beautiful new co-star (guest voice Anne Hathaway). Mr Burns withdraws the staff's free doughnuts at the nuclear power plant.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Million Dollar Maybe: Homer wins the lottery jackpot but has to keep it secret from the family. Guest starring Chris Martin from Coldplay.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.desc: The Psychic Vortex. Leonard is aghast to find out that Penny believes in psychics. Sheldon tries to assist Koothrappali in picking up a girl at a university party. S3, Ep12

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Bozeman Reaction. A robbery of their apartment sees Leonard and Sheldon call on their friends to devise a security system. S3, Ep13

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Einstein Approximation. Stuck on the solution to a physics problem, Sheldon tries different methods to change his thinking, including working at The Cheesecake Factory. S3, Ep14

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Large Hadron Collision. When Leonard is offered a trip to Switzerland on Valentine's Day to see a particle accelerator, he must choose between taking Penny or Sheldon. S3, Ep15

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Excelsior Acquisition. An appearance in traffic court comes at the worst possible time for Sheldon, the same day Stan Lee is appearing at the comic book store. S3, Ep16

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Precious Fragmentation. The guys go to a garage sale and find a ring from the Lord of the Rings films, and the rare find threatens their friendship. S3, Ep17

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Pants Alternative. Sheldon's fear of speaking in front of large groups threatens his ability to accept an award, so the gang tries to help him prepare for the big night. S3, Ep18

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Wheaton Recurrence. Sheldon squares off at the bowling alley against nemesis Wil Wheaton. Leonard's miffed over Penny's response when he says, 'I love you.' S3, Ep19

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Spaghetti Catalysis. Following Leonard and Penny's break up, Sheldon tries to hide from Leonard and the gang that he had a friendly spaghetti dinner at Penny's. S3, Ep20

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Staircase Implementation. A squabble over the thermostat setting leads to Leonard going over to Penny's and recounting the story of how he met and moved in with Sheldon. S3, Ep22

programme.title: A Travelogue of Kent in 1954
programme.desc: A short travelogue describing the history of Kent in 1954, with a look at the towns that made up the Cinque Ports.

programme.title: The Black Book
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Directed by Anthony Mann. Stars Robert Cummings, Richard Basehart & Richard Hart. A powerful man desperately searches for his black book, a list of those marked for the guillotine.

programme.title: Someone at the Door
programme.desc: 1950. Crime. Director: Francis Searle. Stars Michael Medwin, Garry Marsh, Hugh Latimer. Ronnie and Sally discover that a secret passage in their new home is also a storeroom for a gang of thieves.

programme.title: The Gambler and the Lady
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by Patrick Jenkins & Sam Newfield. Stars Dane Clark, Kathleen Byron & Naomi Chance. A gambler attempts to put his past behind him to impress a wealthy girl he has fallen for.

programme.title: Hearts of Tin
programme.desc: A comedic and charming short film following a car race that involves many bumps along the way!

programme.title: Five Days
programme.desc: 1954. Crime. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Stars Dane Clark, Cecile Chevreau & Paul Carpenter. A man on the verge of bankruptcy pays his friend to organise a hit on him, but will his plan pay off?

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: 1946. Drama nominated for an Oscar. Directed by Orson Welles. A war crimes investigator is on the trail of an infamous Nazi. Stars Orson Welles, Edward G. Robinson & Loretta Young.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Arrivals and Departures. 1976. Stars Jean Anderson, Colin Baker & Richard Easton. Paul pushes for further plans for expansion, but a family emergency reveals a new callous aspect to his character.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: The Killing Job. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, William Hartnell and Sydney Tafler. Joss Crawford, boss of London's underworld, gives thug Mick Colletta one hour to leave town.

programme.title: A Good Read: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Blue Carbuncle. Enjoy this classic short story read by Mike Read where Sherlock Holmes investigates a rare gem known as the Blue Carbuncle.

programme.title: The Late Edwina Black
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Maurice Elvey. Stars David Farrar, Geraldine Fitzgerald & Roland Culver. When a Victorian woman dies, a postmortem reveals that her body contains a fatal dose of arsenic.

programme.title: Look At Life Where No Tide Flows
programme.desc: 1963. A fascinating look at canals and how they have been rediscovered by holidaymakers.

programme.title: Strange But True
programme.desc: The Galway Poltergeist. 1997. Micheal Aspel explores a family who claim they have all been terrorised by the same poltergeist and try to rid them of the spirit so they can live in peace.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1956. Destination Death. Director: Montgomery Tully. Stars Russell Napier, Paula Byrne and Melissa Stribling. A body at a London airport, and a flask of poison leads Scotland Yard to Lisbon.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: A Sudden Silence. Stars Barry Foster, Meg Davies & Ronald Hines. The Dutch detective investigates the shooting of a government minister.

programme.title: Jekyll and Hyde (1990)
programme.desc: 1990. Thriller. Directed by David Wickes. Stars Michael Caine, Cheryl Ladd & Joss Ackland. The exciting story of Dr. Henry Jekyll, a tortured scientist whose experiments have hideous consequences.

programme.title: Open Fire
programme.desc: 1994. Crime. Directed by Paul Greengrass. Stars Rupert Graves, Kate Hardie & Jim Carter. A compelling drama capturing the life of one of Britain's most wanted men during the 1980s - David Martin.

programme.title: Fedora
programme.desc: 1978. Drama. Director: Billy Wilder. Stars William Holden, Marthe Keller & Hildegard Knef. A down-on-his-luck Hollywood producer attempts to lure a famous but reclusive actress out of retirement.

programme.title: The Reluctant Bride
programme.desc: 1955. Comedy. Director Henry Cass. Starring John Carroll and Virginia Bruce. A group of children whose parents are missing are looked after by a womanising oil man and a dignified entomologist.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. Client: Brand. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Love from a Stranger
programme.desc: 1937. Drama. Stars Ann Harding, Basil Rathbone & Binnie Hale. A lottery winner breaks up with her fiancé and marries a fortune hunter who proves to be dangerous.

programme.title: Subway in the Sky
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Directed by Muriel Box. Starring Hildegard Knef, Katherine Kath & Van Johnson. A military doctor is falsely accused of dealing illegal drugs. Can he prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Lady Craved Excitement
programme.desc: 1950. Comedy. Directed by Francis Searle. Stars Hy Hazell, Michael Medwin & Sidney James. A cabaret artist seeking adventure gets herself and her partner caught up with shady characters.

programme.title: Orders Are Orders
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. An American film crew are making a film in a British army camp, but the soldiers chase the film unit's girls. Starring Tony Hancock, Sid James & Peter Sellers.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Get up and dance for some 60s rock and roll with That Old Yeah Yeah Feeling by Shane Fenton and The Fentones.

programme.title: The Spider and the Fly
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: A Case of Murder - Part 1. 1974. Stars John Barron & Dorothy Vernon. The Margaret and Kenneth Povey have been accused of the murder of Charles Oldbury and are on trial.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: A Case of Murder - Part 2. 1974. Stars David Savile & Kathleen Byron. The Judge tells the Jury to disregard the defence's blame on Dr. Fulmer. It is found that Mr Oldbury didn't like the Povey's.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: A Case of Murder - Part 3. 1974. Stars Christopher Hancock & Kenneth Watson. Margaret shocks the court revealing that Leonard Saxton, the main benefactor of Mr Oldbury's Will, was her lover.

programme.title: A UK Road Trip in 1959
programme.desc: A short film from 1959 following a road trip through the beautiful countryside, towns and sea fronts in the UK.

programme.title: The Hasty Heart
programme.desc: 1949. Richard Todd, Ronald Reagan & Patricia Neal star in this sensitive adaptation of John Patrick's play about a soldier with little time left & the friendships he makes with those around him.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Decisions. 1972. Stars Robin Chadwick, Michael Hawkins & Hilary Tindall. David decides whether or not to stay in the family business. Meanwhile, a new salesman makes an impression on Jennifer.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: The Very Last Witness. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Diana Decker & George Coulouris. Oscar Brand is involved in black market operations. He hires Mark Saber to trace the man who wishes to kill him.

programme.title: A Hole Lot of Trouble
programme.desc: Directed by Francis A Searle. A 1969 comedy short centring around workmen digging a hole. Starring Arthur Lowe, Victor Maddern, Bill Maynard and Tim Barrett.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 20. 1975. Roger Whittaker and Saffron perform 'New World In The Morning', 'The Seasons Come and the Seasons Go', and Helen Shapiro performs 'Lean On Me'.

programme.title: Framed (1992)
programme.desc: 1992. Thriller. Director: Geoffrey Sax. Stars Timothy Dalton, David Morrissey & Penélope Cruz. When DC Lawrence Jackson goes on holiday, the last person he expects to meet is an escaped criminal.

programme.title: Hot Money
programme.desc: 2001. Crime Drama. Directed by Terry Winsor. Stars Caroline Quentin, Melanie Hill & Georgia Mackenzie. Three women plot to steal thousands of pounds from the Bank of England's incinerators.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Dogs - Part 1. 1974. Stars Tony Selby & Ian Marter. William Broad is charged with conspiring to defraud Ronald Charles by manipulating the odds on the totalisator at Park Royal Racing Stadium.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Dogs - Part 2. 1974. Stars Cheryl Hall, Alan Gerrard & Gerald James. Dog track cashier Doreen Tring gives evidence against Bill Broad and punter Mr. Smith adds to the claims made.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Dogs - Part 3. 1974. Stars Tony Selby, John Alkin & Harry Towb. Bill Broad admits that he was trying to get even with the bookie, but too many people came to help. How will affect his verdict?

programme.title: Sky Liner
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Director: William Berke. Stars Richard Travis, Pamela Blake & Rochelle Hudson. An FBI Agent finds himself caught up in Cold War espionage when he boards a plane heading west.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: In this wonderful music video, Terrie Lomas sings the sensational hit Like I Do.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: 1963. Who Killed Harris Crown? Directed by Don Weis. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. The murder of Mr. Crown is complicated by the fact that Mrs. Crown is pregnant - not by her husband.

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman
programme.desc: 1960. The Rawhiders. Stars Michael Ansara, Peter Whitney & Joe De Santis. Sam acts as a defense attorney for a rawhider who's been accused of a rancher's murder.

programme.title: Tread Softly
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by David MacDonald. Stars Frances Day, Patricia Dainton & John Bentley. The star of a musical walks out before curtain up, but the show must go on, in a 'Haunted Theatre'.

programme.title: Make Me An Offer
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Directed by Cyril Frankel. Starring Peter Finch. The story of Charlie, who as a boy fell in love with a Portland Vase on a trip to a museum, pursues his dream as an antiques dealer.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Island
programme.desc: The Island. 1952. Stars Charles Boyer, Dick Powell, Joel McCrea and David Niven. George catches a shady doctor using a fake name. George falls sick and must be operated on by him.

programme.title: You Were Never Lovelier
programme.desc: 1942. Musical. Directed by William A. Seiter. Stars Fred Astaire, Rita Hayworth & Adolphe Menjou. A down-on-his-luck dancer romances an elegant woman against the wishes of her suspicious father.

programme.title: Look At Life Will Taps Run Dry? 1965
programme.desc: A look at what is being done to ensure that Britain does not face a water shortage.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Sydney Chaplin, Audrey Dalton & Jefferson Clifford. After several killings of thieves occur, a priest is then marked for murder after hearing a confession.

programme.title: Arsenal Stadium Mystery
programme.desc: 1939. Mystery. Director: Thorold Dickinson. Stars Leslie Banks, Greta Gynt, Ian McLean. Poison, death and mystery set at the Arsenal Stadium. Detective Slade is called to solve the crime.

programme.title: A Good Read: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Stockbroker's Clerk. Enjoy this classic short story read by Mike Read where a young clerk consults Holmes with his suspicions concerning a company that has offered him a very well paid job.

programme.title: Captain Pirate
programme.desc: 1952. Adventure. Directed by Ralph Murphy. Stars Louis Hayward, Patricia Medina & John Sutton. A retired buccaneer is forced back onto the high seas to escape execution and clear his good name.

programme.title: The Flying Deuces
programme.desc: 1939. Comedy. Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy join the foreign legion to get over Ollie's broken heart.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Further Enquiries. 1962. Stars Joseph Brady, Brian Blessed & Stratford Johns. PC Weir makes a traffic stop. The events that follow may have lasting impacts for prominent families in the region.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Opening the Cellar Club tonight is Caroline Munro, here to introduce the next episode of The Omega Factor!

programme.title: The Omega Factor
programme.desc: Out of Body, Out of Mind. 1979. Stars James Hazeldine, Louise Jameson & John Carlisle. Michael has a newly discovered ability to dream of incidents which occur at places he has never been to.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Next up, Caroline Munro introduces the 1940s film Case of the Frightened Lady, staring Marius Goring, Penelope Dudley-Ward, Helen Haye & Ronald Shiner!

programme.title: The Case of the Frightened Lady
programme.desc: 1940. Stars Marius Goring, Penelope Dudley-Ward & Helen Haye. Mark's Priory is the family seat of the Lebanons. Lady Lebanon is desperate to have an heir to carry on the family name.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro closes the show but not before exploring what is coming next week at the Cellar Club!

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: Child's Play. 1984. Stars Mary Crosby, Nicholas Clay & Debbie Chasan. A family awakens to find themselves trapped in their own home and must quickly find a way to escape.

programme.title: The System
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Michael Winner. Stars Oliver Reed, Jane Merrow & Barbara Ferris. On the British coast, the local young men mingle among the summer's tourists in search of sexual conquests.

programme.title: The Killings At Outpost Zeta
programme.desc: 1980. Sci-Fi. A team investigates the mysterious deaths of two previous expeditioners to a strategically important part of a barren world.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Award
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars Ida Lupino & Franchot Tone. After failing her first Broadway attempt, a famous movie actress must complete a challenge before she is granted help.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Bee Skeps/Pheasant Shoot. 1986. Jack narrates archive films of a traditional beehive being made from straw and a pheasant shoot with his dog, Bess.

programme.title: The Sword of Monte Cristo
programme.desc: 1951. Adventure. Stars George Montgomery, Rita Corday & Berry Kroeger. Set in 19th Century France, The country's conniving chief minister will stop at nothing to gain possession of the sword.

programme.title: Captain Kidd's Kids
programme.desc: A short comedy film directed by and starring Harold Lloyd about a very troublesome journey out at sea.

programme.title: The Black Arrow
programme.desc: Sir Daniel at the Inn. 1973. Stars Eddie Byrne, Sally James & John Rees. Lord Brock agonises over a crushing defeat by the outlaws. Meanwhile, Sir Richard Shelton's men consider deserting him.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Magic Sword. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. When he announces that Sir Lancelot's sword has magical powers, Merlin courts trouble.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: King Tut's Coup. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. An Egyptology professor believes he is King Tut and kidnaps Lisa. Batman and Robin track him down but end up in troubled waters!

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: The Young Defenders. 1954. Stars Roy Rogers, Trigger & Dale Evans. Outlaws kidnap a fur trapper; his two children are left alone until Roy and Dale come to help.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: Raptures of the Deep. 1964. Stars Ray Barrett, Robert Easton & Gary Miller. While the Stingray crew go to the rescue of two crazy treasure hunters, Troy falls down a crevasse and runs out of air.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Suspect. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Tell must prove a girl innocent of giving information to the Austrians about secret arms shipments.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Slave Ship. 1956. Stars Robert Shaw, Roy Purcell & Earl Cameron. Three slaves escape and take to the sea where they capture a ship for themselves, but they know the British will soon catch up.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Children of the Greenwood. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. A'Bland flees almost certain imprisonment after a false accusation of murder.

programme.title: Beyond the Time Barrier
programme.desc: 1960. Sci-fi. Directed by Edgar G. Ulmer. Stars Robert Clarke & Darlene Tompkins. A military test pilot is propelled into the future where he finds a plague has sterilised the world's population.

programme.title: Ford V8 Car For Ladies 1937
programme.desc: A short film from 1937 explaining the ways automobiles are built to occupy and be owned by women and how cars have and altered and shaped women's lifestyles.

programme.title: Appointment with Venus
programme.desc: 1951. War. Director: Ralph Thomas. Stars: David Niven, Glynis Johns & George Coulouris. During WWII, a British Major is tasked with rescuing a pedigree cow from a German-occupied Channel Island.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. The White Cliffs Mystery. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Yvonne Andre and Peter Bathurst. A dead rocket engineer was being blackmailed. But why - and by whom? (S1, E25)

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Convict Town. 1960. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Alex Cann. Big Tom is determined to stop Chris Cobb from opening a new stage route.

programme.title: The Silent Enemy
programme.desc: 1957. Action. Directed by William Fairchild. Stars Laurence Harvey, Dawn Addams & Michael Craig. During WWII, the British must prevent the Italian Navy from attaching mines to their warships.

programme.title: Look At Life Tails of the Law
programme.desc: 1965. An insight into the interesting jobs police dogs do and how they are trained.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: High Politics. 1962. Stars Rupert Davies, Noel Johnson & Betty McDowell. Maigret must seek out an individual who is attempting to destroy the reputation and career of a government minister.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: A Faint Refrain. 1971. Directed by Gerry Mill. Stars Colin Douglas, Barbara Flynn & Coral Atkins. The iconic seventies drama series continues with the third and final series. (S3, E17)

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Hound of the Baskervilles
programme.desc: 1988. Drama. Director: Brian Mills. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke & Raymond Adamson. Can Sherlock find the truth when the heir to the Baskerville estate is threatened?

programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: Wicked Women. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at Hammer's 'wicked women'! From savage horror to high camp, cult stars and screen legends delivered surprising and shocking performances.

programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: Trials of War. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at Hammer's war films - which ranged from the highly controversial to the ludicrously comedic, such as Up the Creek and Yesterday's Enemy.
